_meta.unit: input/output 单位均为每 1M tokens；海外厂商默认 USD，国内厂商默认 CNY
_meta.note: 以下为参考价格，正式收录前请按官方定价页核对；价格调整见 git history

desc.zh: GPT 系列闭源模型，生态最成熟，支持函数调用、视觉与音频。
desc.en: Closed-source GPT family with the most mature ecosystem; supports function calling, vision and audio.

notes.zh: 缓存命中输入约五折；企业级有批量折扣。
notes.en: Cached input tokens are ~50% off; volume discounts for enterprise.

desc.zh: Claude 系列，长文本与代码能力强，主打安全与企业合规。
desc.en: Claude family, strong at long context and coding, positioned for safety and enterprise compliance.

notes.zh: 缓存写入/读取分价，prompt 缓存可显著降低重复输入成本。
notes.en: Separate prices for cache write vs read; prompt caching cuts repeated input cost.

desc.zh: Gemini 系列，Flash 档价格极低，上下文窗口大，多模态原生。
desc.en: Gemini family; the Flash tier is very cheap with long context and native multimodality.

notes.zh: 免费层有每分钟调用限制，适合个人试用。
notes.en: A free tier exists with per-minute rate limits, good for personal trials.

desc.zh: Grok 系列，实时数据接入，定价对标中端闭源模型。
desc.en: Grok family with live-data access; pricing targets the mid-tier closed-source segment.

notes.zh: 新模型发布初期常有促销价。
notes.en: Launch promotions are common right after a new model ships.

desc.zh: 国产开源权重模型代表，V3/R1 性价比极高，支持 MLA 缓存。
desc.en: Representative open-weight Chinese model; V3/R1 offer extreme value with MLA cache.

notes.zh: 缓存命中输入约 2.5 折；夜间时段批量输入另有折扣。
notes.en: Cache-hit input is ~25% of list price; off-peak batch input is additionally discounted.

desc.zh: 通义千问 API，qwen-plus/max/turbo 分档齐全，新用户有额度。
desc.en: Tongyi Qianwen API with plus/max/turbo tiers; free quota for new users.

notes.zh: 百炼平台对新用户赠送百万级 token 体验额度。
notes.en: DashScope grants million-token trial quota to new users.

desc.zh: 智谱清言 GLM 系列，GLM-4-Plus 对标旗舰，长文本与 Agent 工具链完善。
desc.en: Zhipu GLM family; GLM-4-Plus targets flagship tier with mature long-context and agent tooling.

notes.zh: Flash 档长期免费；旗舰档输入输出同价。
notes.en: The Flash tier is permanently free; the flagship tier charges input and output equally.

desc.zh: Kimi 长文本助手背后的 API，主打超长上下文与文档解析。
desc.en: API behind the Kimi assistant, focused on very long context and document parsing.

notes.zh: 上下文越长单价越高；缓存命中有折扣。
notes.en: Longer context costs more per token; cached prompts are discounted.

desc.zh: 字节跳动豆包大模型，火山方舟托管，pro/lite 分档，价格亲民。
desc.en: ByteDance Doubao models hosted on Volcengine Ark; pro/lite tiers at friendly prices.

notes.zh: 新用户有免费额度；方舟平台同时托管第三方开源模型。
notes.en: Free quota for new users; Ark also hosts third-party open models.

desc.zh: 统一 API 接入数百家模型，按上游原价加约 5%，支持按 token 混合路由。
desc.en: One API for hundreds of models at upstream price plus ~5%, with per-token routing.

notes.zh: 价格即上游价 + 小额手续费；可按性能/价格自动选模型。
notes.en: Price equals upstream plus a small fee; auto-routing can pick the cheapest model that meets quality.

desc.zh: 国产开源模型聚合推理平台，Qwen/DeepSeek/GLM 权重模型一站调用。
desc.en: Aggregated inference for Chinese open-weight models (Qwen/DeepSeek/GLM) under one endpoint.

notes.zh: 部分小模型限时免费；充赠活动常见。
notes.en: Some small models are free for limited time; top-up bonuses are common.
